title: Nil-immersion comparison for Proj of a conormal presentation
statement:
Let $i:Y\hookrightarrow X$ be a closed immersion of Noetherian schemes [def-weil-closed-immersion, pqf-def-locnoeth] with ideal $I$. Let $E$ be a finite locally free $\mathcal O_Y$-module [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module] with a surjection $E\twoheadrightarrow I/I^2$. Regard modules on $Y$ as $\mathcal O_X$-modules by $i_*$, and use the conormal graded algebra and symmetric algebra of [lem-pur-conormal-graded-algebra, lem-weil-pbc-symmetric-algebra-sheaf-construction]. Put
$$A_a=I^a\times_{i_*(I^a/I^{a+1})}i_*\operatorname{Sym}^aE,\quad A=\bigoplus_{a\geq0}A_a,\quad B=\operatorname{Proj}_X A,$$
with multiplication on pairs, using relative Proj [def-nagata-relative-proj]. For any morphism $v:X'\to X$ with $X'$ Noetherian, set $Y'=X'\times_XY$, $I'=I\mathcal O_{X'}$, $v_Y:Y'\to Y$, and $E'=v_Y^*E$ [def-pc-fibre-product, def-pc-module-pullback]. Use the canonical surjection $E'\twoheadrightarrow I'/I'^2$ and define $A'_a$ and $B'$ by the same formula. The natural graded map $v^*A\to A'$ is surjective in every degree and induces a closed immersion
$$h:B'\hookrightarrow X'\times_X B$$
which is an isomorphism over $X'\setminus Y'$ and induces the canonical isomorphism on the inverse-image closed subschemes $P(E')\cong Y'\times_Y P(E)$. The ideal sheaf of $h$ is locally nilpotent; equivalently $h$ is a nil-immersion. In particular it is a universal homeomorphism. Its pullback identifies the degree-one twisting sheaves [def-weil-pbc-proj-twisting-sheaf] and their canonical trivializations over $X'\setminus Y'$. These comparisons respect identities and composition of base morphisms.
